title: Degree-zero representative action formula implies local finite generation
statement: Let X be Noetherian, I a quasi-coherent ideal, F a coherent formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], A any graded sheaf algebra on B_n, and M a graded sheaf module on K_n [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces], [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]. Assume only the following degree-zero representative formula: for every n,U, a in I^n(U), s in K_0(U), and t in F_(n+1)(U) reducing to s, the inclusion of M.act n 0 of the class of a and s equals a times t. Then M.IsLocallyGeneratedInDegreeZero. This constructs neither A nor M and requires no action formula in positive module degree.

source.place: Lemma 087Z, affine proof via Lemma 087W and Section 0EHN; constituent of the parent existence proof, expanded in the Lean docstring.

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood U of the given point. The affine-open adic-sections theorem makes the degree-zero sections a finite module. Choose a Fin r-indexed spanning family s using Module.Finite.exists_fin. Coherence makes degree zero quasi-coherent. For any smaller open V and q in V, choose an affine W contained in V; affine section base change transports the spanning family s to W.

Work in the affine sections tower T on W. Lift the finite family one successor at a time using transition surjectivity. If L is the span of the lifted family, its image is all of the preceding term, so L plus the successor kernel is top. The kernel is I(W)^(n+1)T_(n+1), contained in I(W)T_(n+1). From L plus IT=top, induction gives L plus I^kT=top for every k: multiply the equality by I^k and absorb I^kL into L. The annihilation I^(n+2)T_(n+1)=0 gives L=top. Functoriality shows that the lifts reduce to the fixed s. These two inductions are the fully proved private helpers span_eq_top_of_nilpotent_error and adic_lifts_span; no completion is used.

The inclusion of a restricted section of K_n lies in I(W)^n T_n by the transition-kernel equality; for n=0 this is top. Since the lifted family spans T_n, Submodule.mem_ideal_smul_span_iff_exists_sum gives coefficients c_i in I(W)^n expressing that inclusion as sum c_i*x_i. The affine ideal-power sections formula lifts each c_i to a section a_i of the sheaf I^n; for n=0 use the identity inclusion of O_X.

Apply hact to a_i, the restriction of s_i and x_i. Its equality identifies each c_i*x_i with the inclusion of M.act n 0 of the quotient coefficient and the restriction of s_i. Linearity gives equality of the finite sums after inclusion. Cancel the sectionwise injective kernel inclusion (the identity when n=0), and turn equality into HEq. The chosen affine W, quotient coefficients and unchanged family s satisfy IsLocallyGeneratedInDegreeZero.

theorem formalKernel_graded_action_local_generators {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F : CoherentFormalModule X I)
    (A : GradedSheafAlgebra (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I))
    (M : GradedSheafModule A (formalKernelPiece F))
    (hact : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
      (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).1.val.obj (op U))
      (s : (formalKernelPiece F 0).val.obj (op U))
      (t : (F.obj.obj (op n)).val.obj (op U)),
      (F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.zero_le n)).op).val.app (op U) t =
        (formalKernelι F 0).val.app (op U) s →
      (formalKernelι F n).val.app (op U)
        (M.act n 0 U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I n).val.app (op U) a) s) =
          (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2.val.app (op U) a)) • t) :
    M.IsLocallyGeneratedInDegreeZero
